description: This file defines the Length class within the Opencart system, providing methods for converting, formatting, and retrieving units of length measurements. It interacts with a database to load length class data during instantiation.

classes.name: Length
classes.description: A class that manages length conversions, formatting, and unit retrieval in the Opencart system.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the Length object by loading length class data from the database based on current language settings.

methods.name: convert
methods.description: Converts a length value from one length class to another.

methods.name: format
methods.description: Formats a length value with appropriate decimal and thousand separators and appends the unit.

methods.name: getUnit
methods.description: Retrieves the unit string for a given length class ID.
